evidence: In the distilled local Detectron2 package under codebase/, build_detection_test_loader(cfg, cfg.DATASETS.TEST[0]) raises ValueError: ['dummy_dataset'] is not in list from detectron2/data/build.py:_test_loader_from_config.
steps: Create a config with DATASETS.TEST=('dummy_dataset',), DATASETS.PROPOSAL_FILES_TEST=('dummy.pkl',), and MODEL.LOAD_PROPOSALS=True.
Register a dummy dataset name so the loader path matches the reported eval-only setup.
Observe ValueError because _test_loader_from_config converts the string name to ['dummy_dataset'] and then uses that list as the argument to list(cfg.DATASETS.TEST).index(...).
